evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure readings are null throughout, so the required growth-stage pressure cannot be verified.
Exhaust oxygen was 7.3 ppm near the end of the ramp.
Exhaust oxygen has risen progressively during growth to 44.7 ppm; this raises concern about atmosphere integrity but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 750.3 °C and argon flow 99.9 sccm track their setpoints; controller reports running, which does not verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; growth-stage oxygen acceptance limits and an atmosphere-integrity check are needed to interpret the oxygen rise. No sample characterization is available.
